_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, operate-organisation-scoped-apps. Application.organisationScope: `all` (every organisation sees the app) or `holder` (only members of the organisation OpenRegister stamped on the Application, and of its child organisations). Absent means `all`, so every app from before this fragment behaves as it did. AppOrganisationGuard enforces it at every door that resolves an app (REQ-BQOS-001, REQ-BQOS-002). The register version in openbuild_register.json is bumped so the import runs.

organisationScope.title: Organisation scope
organisationScope.description: Who sees this app: all organisations, or only the organisation that holds it. Absent means all organisations.
